 Watch the Red Hot Chili Peppers Don Rick Rubin Costumes for Rock Hall of Fame Performance 
 By Adrian Garro | November 14, 2026 | 0 Reply 
 At the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony on Saturday night, Rick Rubin was honored with the Music Excellence Award for his decades of work as the producer of some of the biggest albums ever recorded.
 Following a lengthy speech from Neil Young that touched on Rubin’s influence, the Red Hot Chili Peppers took the stage to perform “Give It Away” in recognition of Rubin’s help on their breakthrough 1991 album Blood Sugar Sex Magik .
 But the Chili Peppers did so ALL looking like Rubin, from the signature red-tinted sunglasses to the long, bushy grey beard. It was highly entertaining and quirky in that oh-so-Chili Peppers way.
 Want more stories like this? Click HERE to sign up for our Rock Cellar email newsletter! 
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Ted Stryker (@tedstryker) 
 It was one of many memorable moments from the 2026 induction ceremony.
 Exclusive performances and key moments from the night will air on ABC Tuesday, Dec. 8 from 8-11 p.m. ET (and will be available to stream via Disney+ the next day).
